text: FAO: the cheese resembles feta in appearance, texture and flavour. Like Domiati, the salt goes into the milk, not onto the curd. Starter cultures are not normally used.

steps.note: The curd is kept in a wooden frame until it is about half its volume.
The curd is left under weight overnight.
The curd is held in tins of whey or brine with no culture added, so the milk's own bacteria sour it.
